papers.title: The SPARC Toroidal Field Model Coil Program
papers.direct_claim: Representative-scale REBCO toroidal-field model coil was built and tested at approximately 20 T peak field on the conductor under reported conditions.
papers.application_claim: A compact high-field tokamak can export dependable net electricity.

papers.title: Self-Organizing Knotted Magnetic Structures in Plasma
papers.direct_claim: Full-MHD simulations produce quasistable linked/knotted configurations with nested toroidal surfaces under modeled conditions.
papers.application_claim: Topology-informed magnetic design can improve fusion confinement without unacceptable transport or control costs.

papers.title: Superabsorption in an organic microcavity: Toward a quantum battery
papers.direct_claim: The tested organic microcavity exhibits collective/superextensive charging behavior and energy-storage dynamics.
papers.application_claim: Collective quantum effects can provide useful repeated storage service after charging, discharge and wall-plug losses.

papers.title: Avoiding fusion plasma tearing instability with deep reinforcement learning
papers.direct_claim: A learned predictive/control workflow was experimentally used on DIII-D to avoid tearing instability within the tested regime.
papers.application_claim: Learned controllers can improve plasma performance and robustness against defined baselines.

papers.title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery
papers.direct_claim: Learned models and first-principles calculations enable large-scale computational prediction of candidate stable crystal structures.
papers.application_claim: AI-guided discovery increases the rate of independently verified useful energy materials.

papers.title: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
papers.direct_claim: The corrected article reports autonomous realization of 36 compounds from 57 targets in the campaign.
papers.application_claim: Closed-loop autonomous laboratories can produce reproducible discoveries more efficiently than strong baselines.

papers.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold
papers.direct_claim: The tested surface-code memories operate below threshold with logical-error suppression as code distance increases and real-time decoding.
papers.application_claim: Error correction and decoding can reduce total overhead enough for useful fault-tolerant quantum computation and scientific simulation.

papers.title: Quantum Self-Correction in the 3D Cubic Code Model
papers.direct_claim: The specified 3D cubic-code model has proved lower-bound and numerical evidence for finite-size/temperature-dependent memory-lifetime enhancement.
papers.application_claim: Self-correcting quantum memories are practically useful and implementable at realistic hardware cost.

papers.title: Absence of Quantum Time Crystals
papers.direct_claim: Under stated definitions and assumptions, the specified equilibrium time-crystal behavior is ruled out.
papers.application_claim: Driven/Floquet time-crystalline phases can provide useful synchronization or reliability.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation in Spin Chain Systems
papers.direct_claim: A spin-chain model protocol permits distant local energy extraction using local operations, classical communication and ground-state correlations while respecting causality and local energy conservation.
papers.application_claim: QET can provide a useful practical energy-control or transmission function after all resource costs.
